thag2.18:1.1: A Prācīnavaṁśa was a hall or shed built for the ritual, with bamboo (_vaṁsa_) beams running easterly (_prācīna_; Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 3.1.1.6 and Eggeling’s note).
thag2.18:1.2: This is a reference to [mn31:2.1]() = [mn128:8.1](), where Anuruddha, Kimbila, and Nandiya were practicing together in this grove.
